**Allowed origins:** `http://localhost:4200` (exact), any `*.pages.dev`, and any `*.workers.dev` subdomain.

**Where defined:** `worker/src/index.ts`, inside the `cors()` middleware's `origin` callback (lines ~21-28), passed to `app.use('*', cors({...}))`.

**To add a new custom domain:** edit that same `origin` function in `worker/src/index.ts` — add a condition like `origin === 'https://your-domain.com'` or an `origin.endsWith('.your-domain.com')` check inside the `if (...)` block (array entries only match exact strings, so wildcards must go through this function). See `worker/src/index.md` and `docs/DEPLOYMENT_NOTES.md §4 (CORS)` for details.
